title: Reduction to circuit value
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits. Suppose $C$ is polynomial-time-uniform and every circuit in the family is well formed with at most two inputs to each gate. Then the language accepted by $C$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to the Boolean circuit value language for circuits with at most two inputs per gate.
hypotheses_covered: For every $n$, each circuit $C_n$ is well formed
For every $n$, each gate of $C_n$ has at most two inputs
